name: I am Dhruv Garg
description: My name is Dhruv Garg and I am a B.Tech student passionate about Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
my-description: I am a Computer Science engineering student at SKIT, Jaipur. I specialize in Generative AI, LLM Applications, Prompt Engineering, Machine Learning, and building scalable full-stack applications.
design-info: Building intelligent AI applications using LLMs, RAG pipelines, LangChain, vector databases, and chatbot systems for real-world automation and user interaction.
development-info: Developing predictive models and deep learning solutions using Python, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, and PyTorch for data-driven problem solving.
marketing-info: Performing data cleaning, visualization, and analysis using Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Plotly to extract meaningful business insights.

about-info-1: Hi, I'm Dhruv Garg, a B.Tech student in Computer Science and Engineering at SKIT, Jaipur. I have a strong passion for Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. I love solving complex problems and exploring the real-world applications of Generative AI.
about-info-2: I consider myself an avid learner and a tech enthusiast. Recently, I built an AI-Powered Fraud Detection system using Llama 3 and a Flask-based Image Editor. I also actively participate in hackathons, like the GIT Hackathon 2024 where I secured a top 10 position. In addition, I have hands-on experience in Prompt Engineering, RAG architectures, and deploying large language models to create intelligent conversational agents.
about-info-3: I am constantly honing my skills in Python, Java, SQL, and various modern AI frameworks like LangChain, Hugging Face, PyTorch, and TensorFlow. My goal is to build innovative, scalable, and impactful AI-driven solutions that push the boundaries of data science and automation.

services-questions-1: What is Generative AI and how can it help me?
services-questions-p1: Generative AI uses large language models to automate tasks, generate content, and streamline your business workflows efficiently.
services-questions-2: Do I need a large dataset to train a model?
services-questions-p2: Not always. For many use cases, we can utilize pre-trained models (like Llama 3) and fine-tune them or use RAG with your company documents.
services-questions-3: Is monthly maintenance necessary for AI?
services-questions-p3: Yes, AI models can experience 'data drift'. Regular maintenance ensures the model remains accurate and APIs stay updated.
services-questions-4: How do you deploy these AI solutions?
services-questions-p4: I containerize applications using Docker and deploy them on scalable cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Railway with a frontend interface.
projects-info-1-p2: Built a Generative AI-based conversational agent using Llama 3 via Groq API. It features a dual-layer detection system with 95% accuracy and an automation pipeline to extract structured data.
projects-info-2-p2: Built a web-based image editor using Flask & OpenCV with features like resize, blur, and format conversion. Optimized deployment using Gunicorn + Railway and added automated cleanup.
projects-info-3-p2: An NLP-based movie recommendation platform built with Streamlit. Allows users to search for movies and receive accurate, content-based recommendations.
projects-info-4-p2: A dynamic conversational AI with 4 distinct personality modes (Sad, Anger, Romantic, Normal). It adjusts its responses based on the selected emotional state.
